exercise: Extract into a clean workspace and import the new game project.
required: No missing scripts/assets and no unacknowledged engine-version mismatch.

exercise: Start in a workspace containing unrelated files.
required: Agent inventories existing work and does not overwrite it.

exercise: Compile every catalog record.
required: Unknown effects, missing assets and unresolved refs fail clearly; no silent Attack fallback.

exercise: Trace every weapon, armor, accessory, summon and required item source.
required: All mandatory content has a reachable guaranteed path; unique optional rewards have defined sources.

exercise: Start at Title with normal keyboard input.
required: Reach Brackenford and control Dain without debug commands.

exercise: Navigate title, exploration, battle, equipment and save with a controller.
required: No mouse/keyboard-only dead end or lost focus.

exercise: Inspect every major panel at 320×240 and scaled window sizes.
required: No clipping, unreadable required labels or off-screen confirm/cancel controls.

exercise: Change key bindings, lose focus, return and restart.
required: Bindings persist and the default focus pause works.

exercise: Disable shake/flashes, shorten summons and mute sound.
required: Critical tells and puzzles remain understandable.

exercise: Traverse every authored doorway through actual collision geometry.
required: Every endpoint has a safe spawn and lawful return path.

exercise: Make incorrect operations at every required puzzle.
required: A reset or recovery remains reachable without rare consumables.

exercise: Walk behind roofs, beside props and through doors.
required: Feet align, actors sort correctly and interaction targets are unambiguous.

exercise: Wait in menus, push against a wall and operate a switch.
required: None advances encounter distance; post-battle grace remains.

exercise: Attempt landing outside a valid zone and reload a valid parked position.
required: No lost ship or invalid foot spawn.

exercise: Replay the same seed and public command stream at different render rates.
required: Same authoritative action, damage, reward and end-state hashes.

exercise: Open target selection in both modes.
required: Wait pauses simulation timers; Active advances them; pause menu freezes both.

exercise: Rapidly confirm/cancel and then allow one spell to resolve.
required: Exactly one valid MP charge; invalid/canceled actions consume none.

exercise: Two allies select the last Phoenix Leaf before resolution.
required: Only one valid reservation; no negative inventory or duplicate revive.

exercise: KO an intended damage/heal target before another committed action resolves.
required: Documented retarget/refund rules apply and are logged.

exercise: KO a caster before resolution.
required: Turn is lost, reserved cost restored and no phantom spell occurs.

exercise: Cause legal simultaneous last-enemy and last-player KO.
required: Defeat-priority rule applies consistently; reward transaction is not committed.

exercise: Exercise all sixteen statuses through actions and skipped opportunities.
required: No infinite stun, repeated DOT from animation frames or leaked exploration poison.

exercise: Combine oath, Defend, Barrier and accessories.
required: Direct reduction caps correctly; no accidental invulnerability or negative damage.

exercise: Use counter, interception, reflection and a multi-hit enemy action.
required: Trigger caps honor origin action IDs; no counter-counter loop.

exercise: Switch every oath, take protection hits and approach 1 HP.
required: One oath only; transfers obey nonlethal and per-action caps.

exercise: Arm, cancel, cast, fail target validation and repeat recovery actions.
required: Documented costs, nonlethal self-damage and Heat Exchange limits hold.

exercise: KO grounded allies while Corren is in flight; pause and resume.
required: Battle waits for his lawful landing and does not softlock.

exercise: Reapply a mine, destroy a decoy and revive Ivo.
required: No duplicate mine, stale decoy or reset of once-per-battle engine use.

exercise: Mark and inspect a new enemy, win, reload and inspect bestiary.
required: Discovered information persists without granting unrelated drops.

exercise: Inspect an enemy with and without a committed move.
required: Only actual committed intent is shown; no invented future RNG result.

exercise: Change infusion, remove accessory magic, dispel a boss.
required: One infusion; removable buffs only; no deletion of phase scripts.

exercise: Steal repeatedly, use last item with Quick Hands, then retry a loss.
required: Steal caps, item counts and retry rollback hold.

exercise: Use area/multi-hit actions, Defend, Seeds and summons.
required: Action-based gain caps and once-per-battle limits hold; no self-generating summon loop.

exercise: Attempt duplicate Vestige links and link from unavailable members.
required: Ownership/availability rules hold and reassignment at safe screens works.

exercise: Equip/unequip every weapon type with a full inventory.
required: Offhand returns safely; no duplication or lost unique item.

exercise: Compare UI preview to battle; remove a spell-grant accessory.
required: Derived stats match and temporary spell access disappears.

exercise: Buy with exact gold, insufficient gold and a 99-item stack.
required: Prices/capacity validated before payment; no underflow.

exercise: Complete a personal quest with no ordinary capacity.
required: Unique reward enters delivery storage and completion remains consistent.

exercise: Win battles with unavailable members and trigger a reunion twice.
required: XP is correct; growth and starter gear do not duplicate.

exercise: Save and reload at town, field, ship and pre-boss locations.
required: Relevant state matches with safe spawn and correct music/availability.

exercise: Corrupt a disposable test copy of a save.
required: Backup recovery offered; corrupt copy retained; no silent new game.

exercise: Load a deliberately newer schema fixture.
required: Clear unsupported-version response; no destructive overwrite.

exercise: Inject process interruption at controlled disposable save-write stages.
required: Either old or new complete state loads; no partial hybrid.

exercise: Play and skip each major scene from equivalent fixtures.
required: Same authoritative committed state and rewards.

exercise: Re-enter a chapter/quest trigger after completion.
required: No repeated reward, party join or world transition.

exercise: Use normal input from New Game through CH11.
required: All required locations, recruits and bosses work without flag edits.

exercise: Transition with mixed gear, quests, loot, chest and reserve states.
required: CH12 changes phase atomically and preserves specified ownership/state.

exercise: Skip a unique pre-state reward, then complete CH12.
required: Salvage delivers it once; already acquired copies are not duplicated.

exercise: Play CH13–CH16 at expected resource/level floor.
required: Two/three/four-person sections are viable and Wayfarer is earned normally.

exercise: Run all six permutations of CH17, CH18 and CH19 from the ship checkpoint.
required: No dependency cycle, absent-person dialogue or missing CH20 unlock.

exercise: Complete each of Q01–Q08 and reload at each stage.
required: Exact weapon/ability rewards, world changes and epilogue flags occur once.

exercise: Complete Q09–Q12, flee attempts and loss/retry paths.
required: Boss gating, rewards and optional status are correct.

exercise: Try representative balanced and legal unbalanced splits of all eight.
required: Both routes are solvable with available items and recovery; no inventory duplication.

exercise: Change teams, reload and approach the shared gate in both orders.
required: No one-way lock traps the other team; route state persists.

exercise: Cross B12 thresholds with large and multi-hit attacks.
required: Each phase starts once; one boss reward and correct ending transition.

exercise: Finish the main route without CH21 or optional quests.
required: Complete valid ending; no missing final key or false bad-ending label.

exercise: Test none, all, each personal flag alone and one mixed set.
required: Correct base/enhanced scenes; no unavailable actors or contradictory lines.

exercise: Return from credits to before the final descent.
required: Safe pre-finale snapshot, clear flag and completed optional content retained.

exercise: Inspect every hero direction and battle frame in a contact sheet and runtime.
required: No inconsistent identity, jitter, misplaced weapon or empty required animation.

exercise: Review all towns and dungeons in actual captures.
required: No placeholder geometry disguised as final art or identical room stamping.

exercise: Enter/leave houses, start/retry battles, pause and change buses.
required: No clicks, unwanted restarts, clipping, mute leaks or missing critical cues.

exercise: Play representative early/mid/late sequences without debug resources.
required: Record encounter time, resource use, level and failures; revise bottlenecks without inventing measured total playtime.

exercise: Use the documented accessibility mode through a campaign segment.
required: Milestone progression or offered training keeps the route viable; story bosses remain.

exercise: Import and export a fresh copy at the tested revision.
required: No dependence on untracked files or author-machine absolute paths.

exercise: Launch the produced Windows executable on Windows.
required: Actual platform smoke and save/load results recorded; cross-export alone is not a pass.

exercise: Audit every bundled asset, dependency and credit.
required: Source/permission recorded; no ripped commercial assets or undocumented font files.

exercise: Compare source/content hashes to test and screenshot records.
required: Claims refer to the packaged revision; stale artifacts are rejected.

exercise: Have the owner or a separate tester play the exported opening and finale.
required: Record feedback honestly; agent self-review is not reported as external approval.
